verdict.rationale: Gmail ships AI features (Gemini summarize, draft and suggested replies), so whether user data can be excluded from AI training is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out or of any data-use policy for AI models. OAuth scope narrowing governs third-party app access, which is an adjacent control and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
